title: fix(console): on a desktop the Studio refusal and the AI-unreachable sentence name the app start page
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW
Fixes #37207

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new published language-pack key, console.ai.unavailableErrorDesktop, in all eleven packs
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：桌面端无权进入 Studio 时的「返回首页」按钮改为「返回应用起始页」；AI 服务连不上时的提示句末尾也从「返回首页」改为「返回应用起始页」，与下方按钮一致；手机端不变。
- 为什么做：属于「去掉顶栏和平台首页那一层」专题的收尾，补上上一轮同类改动没覆盖到的两处文字。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某种语言的提示句读起来不顺，跳转目标没有任何改动；可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Measured first, at `origin/main` fbb62e1cc (after #37166 landed): `StudioRoute.tsx` `StudioAccessRequired` read `empty.appAccessDeniedHome` 「Back to home」, and `console.ai.unavailableError` ended "or head back home." on every width. This follows #37204's desktop/phone split (`usePhoneViewport`, under 768 px is a phone).

- `ui/apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`: the Studio refusal's way-home link reads `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome` 「Back to app start page」 from 768 px up, and `empty.appAccessDeniedHome` 「Back to home」 on a phone. `usePhoneViewport` comes from the `@object-ui/app-shell` barrel, which already exports it. The link target (`useHomePath()`) is unchanged.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiUnavailable.tsx`: with `hasError`, the sentence reads the new `console.ai.unavailableErrorDesktop` from 768 px up ("Couldn't reach the AI service. It may be temporarily offline — try again, or go back to the app start page."). A phone keeps `console.ai.unavailableError`. It now names the same place as the button under it.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `console.ai.unavailableErrorDesktop` added once in each of the 11 packs. Each translation reuses that pack's own `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome` wording for "app start page" (zh-Hans 返回应用起始页). No key removed or renamed.

Clause-② measured: leaf keys per pack, base fbb62e1cc → head, read by importing each pack file: en 5040→5041, zh-Hans 5040→5041, zh-Hant/ja/ko/de 5034→5035, fr/es/pt-BR 5191→5192, ru 5348→5349, ar 5662→5663. The new key is present in 11 of 11 packs and absent from all 11 at base. Only this one key is added. Props, exports and targets are unchanged.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiUnavailable.tsx`: the nested `phone` ternary inside `hasError`.
2. `ui/apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`: the link label ternary.
3. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/de.ts` (and the other non-en packs): the translated sentence.

Two-minute check: at a desktop width, sign in as a user without `studio.access` and open `/studio`. The button reads 「Back to app start page」. Narrow the window under 768 px and it reads 「Back to home」.

## Tests

One pin each, at desktop width, with the phone as the CONTROL. Each is a new top-level `describe` in the surface's existing harness:
- Studio refusal: `StudioRoute.test.tsx` "/studio refused: the way home names where it goes, by viewport". At 1280 px the link is 「Back to app start page」 and no 「Back to home」 link exists. CONTROL at 375 px: 「Back to home」.
- AI unreachable: `RequireAiSurface.test.tsx` "the unreachable-service sentence names where its way home goes, by viewport". It renders `AiUnavailable` with `hasError`. Desktop: `console.ai.unavailableErrorDesktop`, not `console.ai.unavailableError`. CONTROL on a phone: the reverse.

Existing pins moved to the desktop wording, because jsdom's window is 1024 px: `StudioRoute.test.tsx` `WAY_HOME`, and `StudioRoute.accessNotice-12035.test.tsx` `wayHomeIn` (now reads `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome` from each pack).

## Acceptance notes

- `RequireAiSurface`'s `redirectTo` prop can still send the button somewhere other than `useHomePath()`. #37204 already accepted this for the button label, and the new sentence takes the same assumption.
- Stale prose that the card lists as not in scope (`runtime-config.ts` `hideSingleAppSwitcher`, `approvals.json`, `studio-authoring.json:35`): none of those files is in this diff, so none is touched.

## Verification

Local: affected suites, both ablations, type-check of the three touched packages, the ui i18n gates, the derived gate families. CI owns the full farm.
